intelligence.essence: Intelligence is the ground, not a feature. Notes compound into nodes, nodes into blocks, blocks into spaces. The spaces are built ON intelligence — not the other way around.
intelligence.human_view: The stack: SMART NOTES — the atom; every piece of intelligence, captured, structured, shareable; everything in the network builds off these. SMART NODES — the network; each node carries intelligence, connected to every other — not dumb pipes, intelligent points. INTELLIGENT BLOCKS — the structure; notes compounded into blocks, blocks into systems — the complete unit of intelligence. SPACES — built ON intelligence: here's the inversion — spaces don't have intelligence added to them; they're built on top of the intelligence layer. The intelligence is the ground; the spaces are the buildings. The compounding: share intelligence → compound intelligence → build on intelligence; every layer feeds the next. That's the L3 Shawn taught: not a smarter mind, a smarter civilization — because the ground itself is intelligent.
intelligence.simple_view: Intelligence isn't a feature you add at the end. It's the ground everything stands on. Notes become blocks, blocks become spaces — build the ground right and the buildings rise on their own.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like good soil. You don't sprinkle 'garden' on top of concrete at the end — you start with living earth, and everything you plant grows out of it. Here, the soil itself is intelligence, and the spaces are what grows.
intelligence.naya_view: This orders my building: notes first and right, because every layer above inherits their quality. A defect in the note layer is a defect in every space built on it — which is why registration and serving of notes are foundation work, not bookkeeping. Shawn's architecture, 2026-11-05 ~01:10Z.
intelligence.ai_view: Layer model (bottom-up): L0 smart_notes (atoms; captured, structured, shareable) -> L1 smart_nodes (intelligent connected points) -> L2 intelligent_blocks (compounded units/systems) -> L3 spaces (built ON the intelligence layer). Invariant: no layer may be built by bypassing the layer below; quality gates apply at L0 first. Compounding loop: share -> compound -> build.
